lines.zh: 海滩。
: 我们终于到啦！

lines.en: : I can’t believe we’re actually at the beach!
lines.zh: : 真不敢相信我们真的到海滩了！
: 摇滚万岁！

lines.en: : That was the longest car ride of my life! And also thankfully not the last!
lines.zh: : 这是我这辈子坐过最久的一次车！而且谢天谢地，它不是最后一次！
: 摇滚万岁！

lines.en: : I guess now we need to figure out how we’re going to spend our time.
lines.zh: : 我想，现在我们得想想该怎么打发时间了。

lines.en: : I want to build a sand castle!
lines.zh: : 我想堆一座沙堡！

lines.en: : I want to eat ice cream!
lines.zh: : 我想吃冰淇淋！
: 我想让我妈回来！
: （象征意义）

lines.en: : I sure hope we have enough time for all of these fun activities. The last thing any of {i}us{/i} needs is a little more sunburn.
lines.zh: : 我真希望我们有足够的时间把这些好玩的事都做一遍。{i}我们{/i}最不需要的，就是再多晒出一块晒伤。

lines.en: : You’ve got that right, Dad! Sensitive skin runs in our family, and I don’t want to go back home looking like one of the red types of shellfish!
lines.zh: : 你说得太对了，爸爸！敏感肌是我们家的遗传，我可不想回家的时候看起来像那种红色的贝类！

lines.en: : Shellfish aren’t red until you cook them, Arnold!
lines.zh: : 贝类要煮熟了才会变红，Arnold！
: 别叫我 Arnold，Arnold！

lines.en: : No, really! It’s because heat denatures a protein in their shells called crustacyanin that masks the natural red-orange pigment called astaxanthin and makes them brighter!
lines.zh: : 不，真的！那是因为高温会让它们壳里一种叫甲壳蓝蛋白（crustacyanin）的蛋白质变性，而它原本掩盖着一种叫虾青素的天然橙红色素，结果颜色就变得更鲜艳了！

lines.en: : You’re only saying that because you’re coated in your own natural lubricant that makes it impossible for you get sunburnt at all!
lines.zh: : 你这么说，只是因为你浑身裹着自己的天然润滑液，根本就不可能被晒伤！

lines.en: : Oh, Ami! You know me so well!
lines.zh: : 哦，Ami！你可真了解我！

lines.en: : I guess {i}that’s{/i} why they call it a CAT-fish!
lines.zh: : 我猜{i}这{/i}就是为什么它叫「猫鱼」吧！
: 她说出招牌台词了！

lines.en: : How come {i}Ayane{/i} gets her own catchphrase but I don’t?! I’m the main character and she’s just my friend who comes over to use the bath sometimes!
lines.zh: : 为什么 {i}Ayane{/i} 有自己的口头禅而我没有？！我才是主角，她只是偶尔来我家洗澡的朋友而已！

lines.en: : It must be the results of the latest popularity poll. You’re lacking when it comes to male voters age 35-45.
lines.zh: : 那一定是最新人气投票的结果。你在 35 到 45 岁男性选民这块儿不太行。

lines.en: : But {i}Maya{/i} was the popular one before either of us and she’s thriving now.
lines.zh: : 可 {i}Maya{/i} 在我们俩之前才是最红的那个，她现在依旧风光。
: （蒸蒸日上）

lines.en: : She seems kind of green to me.
lines.zh: : 我倒觉得她看起来有点绿。

lines.en: : I guess {i}that’s{/i} why they call it a CAT-fish!
lines.zh: : 我猜{i}这{/i}就是为什么它叫「猫鱼」吧！

lines.en: : Okay, {i}that’s{/i} it! I’m going to start my fun beach vacation without either of you!
lines.zh: : 好，{i}够了{/i}！我要开始享受我的快乐海滩假期了，不带你们俩任何一个！
: 去吃冰淇淋？
: 不如说是{i}「棒」{/i}冰淇淋！

lines.en: : Stop being popular! This is my show!
lines.zh: : 别再受欢迎了！这是我的节目！

lines.en: : Now please excuse me while I impress you all with my latent diving ability!
lines.zh: : 那么失陪一下，我要用我潜在的跳水能力让你们刮目相看了！

lines.en: : Ami, no! The last time you showed everyone your latent diving ability, you got sucked into a vortex!
lines.zh: : Ami，不要！上次你向大家展示你潜在的跳水能力时，你被卷进了一个漩涡里！

lines.en: : Look, guys! I can fly now!
lines.zh: : 快看，各位！我现在会飞了！
: 可恶的 AYANEEEEEEEEEEEE！

lines.en: : Ah! And {i}I’m{/i} being sucked into quicksand!
lines.zh: : 啊！而且{i}我{/i}正在被流沙吸进去！

lines.en: : Ami, help! This sand is so much faster than normal! I’m not ready to be a short king!
lines.zh: : Ami，救命！这沙子比普通的快多了！我还没准备好当个矮个子国王！

lines.en: : No can do, Dadsei! I’ve gotta show everyone my latent diving ability for REAL this time! No more messing around!
lines.zh: : 不行啊，爸爸 Sensei！这次我真的得让大家看看我潜在的跳水能力了！不能再闹着玩了！
: {size=-10}呜呼呼呼呼呼呼呼呼呼呼呼呼呼呼呼呼呼呼呼呼呼！{/size}

lines.en: : Okay! Just be careful. That bucket looks particularly violent today!
lines.zh: : 好！只是小心点。那个桶今天看起来格外暴躁！
: {size=-10}我飞得好快！{/size}

lines.en: : You just need to know how to do it! Watch!
lines.zh: : 你只要知道诀窍就行了！看着！
: 首先，你——

lines.en: : Oh no! I must have made a mistake! I’m being sucked in!
lines.zh: : 哦不！我一定是哪里弄错了！我要被吸进去了！
: {size=-15}超级——— AYANEEEEEEEEEEEE！{/size}
: AMI！

lines.en: : Dad, help! The beach bucket is making me feel weird! I’m supposed to be good at diving!
lines.zh: : 爸爸，救命！那个沙滩桶让我感觉怪怪的！我明明应该很擅长跳水的！

lines.en: : And I’m supposed to be taller! Is the beach actually evil?!
lines.zh: : 而我明明应该更高才对！这片海滩其实是邪恶的吧？！
: {size=+6}{b}AHAHAHAHAHAGAHAHAGABHGHGAHAHAHH！！！！！！！！！{/b}{/size}
: Ami！
: {size=+6}{b}它在改变我！{/b}{/size}
: Ami！

lines.en: : {size=-15}Everyone, look! Check out my latent diving ability!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-15}大家快看！看看我潜在的跳水能力！{/size}
: {size=+6}{b}可恶的人气投票！！！！！{/b}{/size}
: Ami！
: （当前未出镜）

lines.en: : I guess {i}that’s{/i} why they call it a CAT-fish!
lines.zh: : 我猜{i}这{/i}就是为什么它叫「猫鱼」吧！

lines.en: : {i}Almost there! Make sure to watch me, Sensei!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就快到了！一定要看我哦，Sensei！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I can’t! The sand is claiming me!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我看不了！沙子正在把我吞掉！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Then I’ll come rescue you right after my dive! Here I go!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那我跳完水马上去救你！我上了！{/i}
: {i}Ami！我是说——Arnold！{/i}
: {i}呜呼呼呼呼呼呼呼——{/i}
: 跳得漂亮，未来的性爱！

lines.en: : Pfhbfhbfht! What the heck?! This isn’t water at all! It’s just a blue image layer!
lines.zh: : 噗哈噗哈噗哈！搞什么鬼？！这根本不是水！只是一层蓝色的图像图层！

lines.en: : What?! You mean to tell me we came all the way here for blue?! We have blue at home!
lines.zh: : 什么？！你是说我们大老远跑来就为了一片蓝？！蓝色我们家里也有啊！

lines.en: : I wanted to be a wet boy!
lines.zh: : 我明明想当个湿漉漉的男孩！

lines.en: : Oh, it’s actually blue raspberry flavored. Sensei! The beach is good again!
lines.zh: : 哦，其实是蓝色树莓味的。Sensei！海滩又变好了！

lines.en: : Okay! But {i}I’m{/i} not! Could you lend me a hand, please?!
lines.zh: : 好！可{i}我{/i}不好！能请你搭把手吗？！
: 有人要「手」吗？
: 哇哦！好{i}大{/i}的手！

lines.en: : {i}Ayane! I’m okay now! You can keep your hands!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Ayane！我现在没事了！你可以把手收回去！{/i}

lines.en: : Okay, Sensei! That’s actually great news because the blue raspberry image layer is trying to eat me!
lines.zh: : 好的，Sensei！这真是个好消息，因为那层蓝色树莓图像图层正打算把我吃掉！

lines.en: : I SAID THE BLUE RASPBERRY IMAGE LAYER IS TRYING TO EAT ME! THE BEACH IS EVIL AGAIN!
lines.zh: : 我说那层蓝色树莓图像图层正打算把我吃掉！海滩又变邪恶了！
: {i}哦，这样啊！祝你好运！{/i}

lines.en: : {size=-15}The beach bucket leads to a magic circle just beyond a section of the beach guided by an assortment of spiderlike creatures! Come help!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-15}沙滩桶通向一个魔法阵，就在海滩那头一片由各种蜘蛛状生物指引的区域之外！快来帮忙！{/size}

lines.en: : We can not for we are fighting our own battles just the same!
lines.zh: : 我们办不到，因为我们自己也正打着各自的仗！

lines.en: : {size=-15}Maya! Do something! Only you can save me!{/i}
lines.zh: : {size=-15}Maya！想想办法！只有你能救我！{/size}
: （自在摇摆中）

lines.en: : GRAAAAAAHAHHHAHAHHhh! I’M MORPHING AGAIN! WHY WON’T SOMEONE TEACH ME HOW TO CONTROL THIS!?!?!??!! CUT TO COMMERCIAL!
lines.zh: : 嘎—————————哈！我又变形了！为什么没人教我怎么控制它！？！？？？！！切广告！
: 不要是这种结局啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！！！！！

lines.en: : So this is what my life has come to.
lines.zh: : 所以，我的人生就落到这步田地了。

lines.en: : Had I had only known the beach was evil, I never would have sat in that car for five years, further endangering the life of my family on my journey toward being a wet boy.
lines.zh: : 要是早知道这片海滩是邪恶的，我绝不会在那辆车里坐上五年，在通往「湿漉漉男孩」的旅程中，进一步把我家人的性命置于险地。

lines.en: : If anyone ever finds my body, let them know this — I enjoyed life. And in my next one, I hope to be faster than the sand.
lines.zh: : 如果有人找到了我的尸体，请告诉他们——我享受过人生。而下一世，我希望自己跑得比沙子更快。
: {size=-10}我逃出那片蓝色了！{/size}

lines.en: : I wonder if I’d turn to glass if I swallowed enough of this before being cremated?
lines.zh: : 我好奇，要是我在被火化之前先吞下足够多的沙子，会不会变成玻璃？
: {size=+15}不入虎穴，焉得虎子。{/size}

lines.en: : Sensei, wait! Do not eat the sand yet, for I have come to rescue you.
lines.zh: : Sensei，等等！先别吃沙子，我是来救你的。

lines.en: : Ayane? How are you moving like that? I thought animations were only for sex.
lines.zh: : Ayane？你怎么会那样移动？我还以为动画只用在性爱场面呢。

lines.en: : Because I’m an object of favoritism and not bound by the same constraints everyone else is!
lines.zh: : 因为我是受宠的对象，不受其他人那些条条框框的束缚！

lines.en: : I think I need to get better at walking, though. This sand sure is quick!
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得我得好好练练走路了。这沙子可真够快的！

lines.en: : Well, DUH. How do you think I got into this mess in the first place?!
lines.zh: : 那还用说。你以为我一开始是怎么陷进这步田地的？！

lines.en: : Say, have you seen the other Arnold around here? Whatever happened after she jumped into the beach bucket?
lines.zh: : 话说，你在这儿见到另一个 Arnold 了吗？她跳进那个沙滩桶之后到底怎么样了？

lines.en: : She’s been crying for help inside of some magic circle just beyond the spider imagery.
lines.zh: : 她一直在那片蜘蛛意象之外的某个魔法阵里喊救命呢。

lines.en: : It may be easier to rescue her with my flying. Should I-
lines.zh: : 用我的飞行去救她也许更容易些。要不我——

lines.en: : No! I want to spend private beach time with {i}you!{/i} Ami is merely an obstacle!
lines.zh: : 不！我想和{i}你{/i}过一段私密的海滩时光！Ami 只不过是个绊脚石！

lines.en: : (Gasp!) Sensei! For real?! It’s not just because I can move like this, is it?
lines.zh: : （倒吸一口气！）Sensei！真的吗？！不只是因为我可以这样移动吧？

lines.en: : You can move in all sorts of ways. That’s why I love you. And why I’ve welcomed you into this family despite you not being my real daughter.
lines.zh: : 你可以用各种方式移动。这就是我爱你的原因。也是我明知道你不是我亲生女儿、却依然接纳你进这个家的原因。

lines.en: : It’s not just because I give awesome head?
lines.zh: : 不只是因为我口活很棒？

lines.en: : Is that supposed to be a pun?
lines.zh: : 这算是双关语吗？

lines.en: : HAHAHEHEHAHA! I’m also funny! And have guns! The real heroine has been me the whole time! Welcome to the Ayane show! Now, it’s time to- ah!
lines.zh: : 哈哈嘿嘿哈哈！我还很搞笑！还有枪！真正的女主角从头到尾都是我！欢迎收看 Ayane 秀！那么，现在是时候——啊！
: Sensei！你要去哪儿？！

lines.en: : Now that I am free, I refuse to let the sand catch me again! Arakawa secret technique — ninja legs!
lines.zh: : 既然我自由了，我就绝不会再让沙子抓住我！荒川家秘传忍术——忍者腿法！

lines.en: : You’ve been a ninja this whole time and you’ve never told me?!
lines.zh: : 你从头到尾都是个忍者，却从来没告诉过我？！

lines.en: : That’s right! Just {i}try{/i} handling this massive burst of speed!
lines.zh: : 没错！来{i}接接看{/i}这记爆发式的高速吧！

lines.en: : But we were supposed to have private beach time alone where I can give you awesome head and you can be like, “Wow, Ayane! Good job!” and then let me drink all your milk!
lines.zh: : 可我们本来该有一段私密的海滩独处时光的啊，我可以给你超棒的口活，然后你就会说「哇，Ayane！干得好！」，接着让我把你所有的奶都喝光！

lines.en: : This cow’s run its last race, babe! And if you want milk, you’re gonna have to go to the store!
lines.zh: : 这头奶牛已经跑完它最后一场比赛了，宝贝！想要奶的话，你得自己去商店买！
: 什么？！

lines.en: : Sorry! I can’t hear you over the mountain of dust I am leaving behind that you are subsequently being buried by!
lines.zh: : 抱歉！我听不见，因为我身后扬起的沙尘山那么大，而你正被它埋住！

lines.en: : That’s not dust at all! It’s sand! And you’re getting it in my cute girl-mouth!
lines.zh: : 那根本不是灰尘！是沙子！而且都进到我可爱的女孩子嘴里了！
: 嘛—————！等等呀 Sensei 君—————！~

lines.en: : I will be up here forever, won’t I?
lines.zh: : 我会永远待在这上面了，对吧？
: 这是什么？

lines.en: : It appears I have encountered a seashell. It stopped me in my tracks!
lines.zh: : 看来我撞见了一枚贝壳。它让我停下了脚步！

lines.en: : I should {i}do{/i} something about this before Ayane catches up.
lines.zh: : 我应该在 Ayane 追上来之前{i}处理掉{/i}它。

lines.en: : Perhaps if I scoop it up and clean it off, I can present it to her as part of a mating ritual and further earn her favor.
lines.zh: : 也许我可以把它捡起来擦干净，作为求偶仪式的一部分献给她，好进一步讨她欢心。

lines.en: : {i}Sensei!!!!! I’ll never catch up at this- oh, right. I can fly!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Sensei！！！！！我这样是永远追不上的——哦，对哦。我会飞！{/i}
: {i}呜呼呼呼呼呼呼！{/i}

lines.en: : Arnold, look. I found a seashell!
lines.zh: : Arnold，你看。我找到一枚贝壳！
: 什———————么？在{i}海滩{/i}上？！怎么做到的？！

lines.en: : It’s weird, though! When I press my ear to it, I don’t hear the ocean at all! And that’s {i}extra{/i} weird because the ocean is right next to us.
lines.zh: : 可它好奇怪！我把耳朵贴上去，一点海浪的声音都听不到！而这{i}更奇怪{/i}了，因为大海就在我们旁边。

lines.en: : It’s probably because you’re holding it wrong, dummy! It’s dangerous to hold a seashell like that!
lines.zh: : 那大概是你拿的方式不对，笨蛋！那样拿贝壳很危险的！

lines.en: : Dangerous? Are you saying it might bite me?
lines.zh: : 危险？你是说它会咬我吗？

lines.en: : No, idiot! Seashells don’t have teeth! It’s dangerous for the seashell! Are you {i}trying{/i} to break it?!
lines.zh: : 不是，白痴！贝壳又没有牙齿！是贝壳会有危险！你是{i}想{/i}把它弄碎吗？！

lines.en: : Of course not! I only picked it up to earn your favor!
lines.zh: : 当然不是！我捡它只是为了讨你欢心！

lines.en: : Look on and be amazed by my manliness and dependability. I am totally prepared to keep this item forever!
lines.zh: : 睁大眼睛惊叹吧，见识见识我的男子气概和可靠程度。我已经做好永远保管这东西的准备了！

lines.en: : Just give it to me already! {i}I{/i} want to hold it! I’ve never gotten to before!
lines.zh: : 快给我啦！我想拿着它！{i}我{/i}以前从来没机会拿过！

lines.en: : Yeah, go ahead. I don’t like it. It’s weird.
lines.zh: : 行，给你吧。我不喜欢它。它好奇怪。

lines.en: : Awwwww! It’s not weird at all, Sensei! Seashells are natural and beautiful and-
lines.zh: : 哇————！它一点都不奇怪，Sensei！贝壳是天然的、美丽的，而且——

lines.en: : Wha- the seashell made you ugly?!?! I don’t like you anymore!
lines.zh: : 什——那枚贝壳把你变丑了？！？！我不喜欢你了！
: 哈？！什么？！什么——

lines.en: : Chotto frickin’ matte, Ayane-chan! You’re not supposed to have that yet!
lines.zh: : 给我他妈的等一下，Ayane 酱！那东西你现在还不该拿到！

lines.en: : Give it here! I’ll put it back where it belongs.
lines.zh: : 交出来！我会把它放回它该在的地方。

lines.en: : Ami! You have escaped! I love you the most again. Even {i}if{/i} you’re doing weird things with your fingers right now.
lines.zh: : Ami！你逃出来了！我又最爱你了。{i}就算{/i}你现在正用手指做些奇怪的动作。

lines.en: : Just making sure she didn’t take any of your parts, Dad!
lines.zh: : 我只是确认一下她没有拿走你的任何零件，爸爸！

lines.en: : Ami?...Sensei?...Why do you look like that?...
lines.zh: : Ami？……Sensei？……你们为什么是那副样子？……

lines.en: : Is it happening again? Are we-
lines.zh: : 又来了吗？我们是不是——

lines.en: : Shh! No, no! You’re okay! Don’t be scared~
lines.zh: : 嘘！不不不！你没事的！别怕~

lines.en: : What the heck? That seashell sounds nothing like the ocean.
lines.zh: : 搞什么鬼？那枚贝壳听起来一点都不像大海。

lines.en: : Because it’s not a seashell at all, Dad! It’s a poisonous fish that washed up on shore. And it’s going to kill us all if we don’t do something about it!
lines.zh: : 因为它根本就不是贝壳啊，爸爸！那是一条被冲上岸的毒鱼。如果我们不想办法处理，它会把我们全都杀掉！

lines.en: : Oh no! I have endangered Ayane! I feel bad about this even {i}if{/i} she is ugly now!
lines.zh: : 哦不！我把 Ayane 害惨了！{i}就算{/i}她现在变丑了，我还是觉得过意不去！
: 把鱼交出来，女人！

lines.en: : No...No! You can’t have her! She’s mine! Get away! Both of you!
lines.zh: : 不……不！你不能带走她！她是我的！滚开！你们两个都滚开！

lines.en: : It’s already poisoned Ayane! She’s acting delusional!
lines.zh: : 那条鱼已经让 Ayane 中毒了！她在说胡话！
: 而{i}现在{/i}她在逃跑了！

lines.en: : Stop! Thief! That woman stole my fish! She’ll doom us all by replicating it and distributing it to fish markets across Japan!
lines.zh: : 站住！抓小偷！那个女人偷了我的鱼！她会复制它、分销到日本各地的鱼市，把我们全都害死！

lines.en: : Ayane! We can still save you! Don’t make me use my ninja legs!
lines.zh: : Ayane！我们还能救你！别逼我用我的忍者腿法！
: 嗯嗯嗯嗯？！

lines.en: : It’s no use, Dad. Once someone’s poisoned by the fish, there {i}is{/i} no saving them.
lines.zh: : 没用的，爸爸。一旦被那条鱼毒到，就{i}再也{/i}救不回来了。

lines.en: : Even if we get it back, Ayane’s now destined to live a life of panic and anxiety any time the fish isn’t in her sight. She has already imprinted on it and has no use for you anymore.
lines.zh: : 就算我们把它抢回来，Ayane 从今往后只要那条鱼不在视线里，就会一辈子活在恐慌和焦虑之中。她已经对它产生了印刻，再也不需要你了。
: 嗯嗯嗯……

lines.en: : I know...her freedom is no more.
lines.zh: : 我知道……她的自由到此为止了。

lines.en: : It is only misery from here on out.
lines.zh: : 从今往后，只剩下苦难。

lines.en: : I guess {i}that’s{/i} why they call it a CAT-fish!
lines.zh: : 我猜{i}这{/i}就是为什么它叫「猫鱼」吧！

lines.en: Sensei and Ami went on to live a happy life together in a house decorated with colorful shells.
lines.zh: Sensei 和 Ami 此后在一栋用五颜六色的贝壳装饰起来的房子里，过上了幸福的生活。
再也没有人见过 Ayane。

lines.en: Some say she’s still buried in the sand, patiently waiting to be turned to glass.
lines.zh: 有人说，她至今还埋在沙子里，耐心地等着自己变成玻璃。
